description: Source code for the VCNL36825T proximity sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register configuration, I2C communication, power management, and sensor data fetching.

methods.name: vcnl36825t_read
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit value from a specified register over I2C.

methods.name: vcnl36825t_write
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a specified register over I2C.

methods.name: vcnl36825t_update
methods.description: Reads, modifies, and writes back register value with a mask.

methods.name: vcnl36825t_pm_action
methods.description: Handles power management actions (resume, suspend) for the device.

methods.name: vcnl36825t_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data (proximity) from the device.

methods.name: vcnl36825t_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the sensor channel data (proximity value).

methods.name: vcnl36825t_init_registers
methods.description: Initializes device registers with default values.

methods.name: vcnl36825t_init
methods.description: Initializes the device, checks device ID, and configures registers.
